articles.title: 1Password ha sido hackeado
articles.text:
Hemos aprendido que utilizar la misma contraseña para todo no es una buena idea, que conviene generar claves largas y difíciles de adivinar y que nuestra memoria tiene sus límites. Los gestores de contraseñas nos han permitido resolver buena parte de ese problema: podemos proteger decenas de cuentas sin tener que recordar cada una de sus claves de acceso. Pero delegar esa tarea también supone depositar una enorme confianza en quienes desarrollan estas herramientas. Y esa confianza se pone a prueba cuando son precisamente esas empresas las que sufren un ciberataque.
1Password, uno de los gestores de contraseñas más conocidos del mercado, ha comunicado que ha sufrido una intrusión en sus sistemas internos. La compañía canadiense reconoce que un atacante ha conseguido sustraer información de una parte de sus clientes, incluidos sus nombres y direcciones de correo electrónico. Sin embargo, asegura que las bóvedas en las que los usuarios almacenan sus contraseñas y otros datos confidenciales no se han visto comprometidas y que sus aplicaciones y servicios funcionan con normalidad. La empresa, que afirma contar con millones de clientes, todavía no ha precisado cuántos han resultado afectados.
La investigación comenzó el 19 de noviembre, cuando 1Password detectó indicios de que un atacante había conseguido acceder a la cuenta corporativa de GitHub de uno de sus empleados. Aprovechó ese acceso para introducir código malicioso en los servicios internos y extraer información de clientes. También copió código fuente de repositorios privados y accedió al sistema de integración y entrega continuas (CI/CD), que automatiza procesos de desarrollo y despliegue de software y contiene credenciales de la infraestructura. La compañía ha renovado o revocado aquellas que podrían haberse visto expuestas, aunque todavía se desconoce cómo se produjo el acceso inicial.
Qué datos han quedado expuestos y qué significa para nuestras contraseñas
Entre la información sustraída encontramos identificadores de cuentas y usuarios, fechas de creación y del último inicio de sesión, claves públicas, parámetros del protocolo de autenticación Secure Remote Password (SRP) y otros metadatos internos. Especial atención merecen los tokens presentes en determinados enlaces de invitación, aprovisionamiento y recuperación de cuentas. Según la compañía, completar una invitación de aprovisionamiento o una recuperación requiere una verificación adicional mediante un inicio de sesión único (SSO) o un código enviado al correo electrónico registrado. La empresa ha notificado específicamente a un pequeño grupo de usuarios que se encontraba en estos procesos durante el incidente.
Para entender por qué una intrusión de este tipo no implica necesariamente el acceso a nuestras contraseñas, conviene detenernos en cómo funciona 1Password. En las cuentas convencionales, el sistema combina la contraseña que elegimos con una segunda clave, denominada Secret Key, que se genera en nuestro dispositivo. Ambos elementos intervienen en la derivación de las claves criptográficas que protegen las bóvedas, sin que la compañía almacene esos dos secretos. Este diseño añade protección frente a los intentos de adivinar nuestra contraseña si alguien consigue sustraer los datos cifrados. En este incidente, la empresa asegura que el contenido de las bóvedas ni siquiera estuvo al alcance del atacante.
¿Qué debemos hacer si utilizamos este gestor? La compañía considera que no necesitamos modificar las credenciales de nuestra cuenta de 1Password como consecuencia del incidente, pero recomienda extremar la precaución ante correos electrónicos, mensajes de texto o llamadas inesperadas. Los datos sustraídos podrían facilitar intentos de suplantación de identidad, por lo que la empresa recuerda que nunca contactará con sus clientes para pedirles la contraseña de su cuenta o su Secret Key. Internamente, ha reforzado sus controles de seguridad y ampliado de seis dígitos numéricos a diez caracteres alfanuméricos los códigos utilizados en determinados procesos de invitación y recuperación.
Tenemos un precedente que nos ayuda a poner lo ocurrido en perspectiva. En diciembre de 2022, LastPass reconoció que un atacante había conseguido sustraer una copia de seguridad de las bóvedas de sus clientes, que contenía información sin cifrar, como las direcciones de los sitios web, además de contraseñas y otros datos cifrados. El alcance del incidente de 1Password es diferente, según la información publicada hasta ahora. La compañía ha recurrido a expertos independientes para validar sus medidas de contención y remediación. Ambos casos ilustran por qué, cuando hablamos de la seguridad de un gestor de contraseñas, importa tanto su capacidad para prevenir una intrusión como para limitar sus consecuencias.

articles.title: Notée 5/5, cette tablette Apple perd 110,67 € à l'occasion du Black Friday 2026
articles.text:
Black Friday 2026 : La tablette Tactile Apple iPad Air 13 pouces (M4) 512 Go "5 étoiles" à 1 239,00 €
Actuellement notée 5 étoiles par notre rédaction, l'Apple iPad Air 13 pouces (M4) offre une puissance de premier ordre pour le travail et la création grâce à sa puce M4 et son écran bien calibré. Le Black Friday fait descendre son prix à 1 239,00 € chez Amazon, soit une baisse d'environ 8 % et 110,67 € d'économie.
L'Apple iPad Air 13 pouces (M4) s'adresse aux utilisateurs cherchant une grande surface d'affichage pour la bureautique, la création et la consommation multimédia. Avec l'intégration de la puce M4 et son format agrandi, l'appareil avait convaincu notre laboratoire lors de ses tests.
À l'occasion du Black Friday, la tablette descend à 1 239,00 € chez Amazon, soit environ 8 % de moins que le prix moyen constaté ces 30 derniers jours fixé à 1 349,67 €. Cette baisse de prix permet d'économiser 110,67 €.
Une puce M4 véloce et un grand écran parfaitement calibré
Avec sa puce Apple M4 couplée à 12 Go de mémoire vive, l'iPad Air délivre une puissance de calcul adaptée aux flux de travail lourds sans faiblir. La dalle LCD de 13 pouces assure un confort visuel appréciable pour afficher plusieurs applications côte à côte, comme le souligne notre test complet. Notre laboratoire a mesuré une luminosité maximale de 612 cd/m², ce qui permet de conserver une lecture parfaitement lisible en extérieur ou sous un éclairage direct.
Apple iPad Air 13 pouces (M4)
Points forts
- Conception impeccable.
- Écran bien calibré.
- Puissance de la puce M4.
- Autonomie en hausse.
Points faibles
- Affichage limité à 60 Hz.
- Accessoires (non fournis) hors de prix.
- Charge trop lente.
Une autonomie solide mais une charge qui prend son temps
Sur notre banc d'essai, cette tablette tactile a atteint 19 heures et 6 minutes d'autonomie, ce qui assure plus d'une journée complète d'usage intensif loin d'une prise. Il faut en revanche composer avec un temps de charge mesuré à 134 minutes et une dalle cantonnée à un taux de rafraîchissement de 60 Hz, deux limites qui ne gêneront toutefois pas ceux qui privilégient l'endurance et rechargent leur équipement la nuit.
Apple iPad Mini (A20 Pro) : l'autre option face au Apple iPad Air 13 pouces (M4)
L'iPad Mini mise sur un format très compact équipé d'une dalle Oled, pensé pour être emporté partout d'une seule main. À l'inverse, l'iPad Air 13 pouces privilégie un vaste espace de travail pour remplacer plus facilement un ordinateur portable au quotidien.
L'iPad Mini est vendu 539,01 € moins cher que l'iPad Air 13 pouces, mais ce dernier conserve un net avantage pour la création et le multitâche grâce à la diagonale de son écran et la puissance de sa puce M4.

- Très bonne autonomie.
- Poids ultra-léger.
Points faibles
- Charge lente.
- Stockage de 128 Go en 2026.
- Taux de rafraîchissement limité à 60 Hz.

articles.title: Elon Musk hizo su propio Instagram: creó un editor de videos verticales para creadores
articles.text:
X, la red social de Elon Musk, anunció una serie de herramientas destinadas a facilitar la creación y publicación de videos verticales dentro de la plataforma. La actualización incorpora un editor multimedia con funciones de grabación, edición y posproducción, con el objetivo de que los creadores produzcan contenido sin recurrir a aplicaciones externas.
La compañía busca aumentar la cantidad de videos originales y competir por la atención de los usuarios frente a servicios como YouTube, Instagram y TikTok.
Las novedades forman parte de una estrategia para convertir los videos cortos en uno de los principales formatos de contenido de la red social propiedad de Elon Musk. Además de ofrecer nuevas opciones de edición, X pretende que los creadores tengan más oportunidades de generar ingresos a partir de sus publicaciones.
La disponibilidad de estas herramientas dependerá de la región, según informó la compañía. Algunas funciones ya se habían presentado durante los últimos meses, mientras que otras se incorporan ahora para ampliar las posibilidades de producción audiovisual.
X incorpora un editor para crear videos verticales sin salir de la aplicación
Una de las principales novedades es la actualización del editor multimedia de X. Esta herramienta permitirá grabar, modificar y publicar videos verticales directamente desde la plataforma, sin necesidad de utilizar programas de edición externos.
Entre las opciones de grabación se encuentra la posibilidad de capturar videos por segmentos, una función útil para combinar diferentes tomas en una misma publicación. También incorpora efectos de pantalla verde, que permiten sustituir el fondo de una grabación por otra imagen o escenario.
El editor incluye herramientas de posproducción para adaptar el contenido antes de compartirlo. Los creadores podrán convertir videos horizontales en formato vertical, recortar fragmentos, generar subtítulos automáticamente y agregar textos superpuestos.
También tendrán la posibilidad de seleccionar miniaturas personalizadas para sus publicaciones y realizar ajustes en fotografías. Estas opciones buscan simplificar el proceso de producción, especialmente para quienes publican contenido de manera frecuente.
Con esta actualización, X intenta reducir la dependencia de aplicaciones externas y ofrecer un entorno en el que los creadores puedan completar todo el proceso audiovisual.
Los usuarios podrán compartir hasta 20 fotos y videos en una publicación
Otra de las novedades recientes de la plataforma permite incluir hasta 20 fotografías y videos en una sola publicación. Los usuarios podrán recorrer el contenido deslizando el dedo horizontalmente, en una experiencia similar a la de una galería multimedia.
X considera que esta herramienta puede resultar útil para compartir resúmenes de eventos, imágenes detrás de cámaras, lanzamientos de productos y otros contenidos que requieren mostrar varias escenas.
La función amplía las posibilidades de las publicaciones tradicionales, que anteriormente tenían mayores limitaciones para combinar diferentes archivos multimedia en una misma entrada.
La compañía también presentó a comienzos de noviembre una herramienta para recortar videos largos y convertirlos en fragmentos más breves. Los usuarios pueden seleccionar una parte de una grabación, añadir sus propios comentarios y compartirla sin abandonar X.
Un aspecto importante es que estos clips conservan el crédito y un enlace al video original. Además, tanto la persona que publica el fragmento como el creador del contenido inicial pueden recibir ingresos por las visualizaciones, según las condiciones del programa.
X busca que los creadores ganen más dinero con sus videos
La estrategia de la plataforma no se limita a mejorar las herramientas de edición. X también está incorporando programas para incentivar la publicación de videos originales y fortalecer su sistema de monetización.
Uno de ellos es el denominado Bono de Inicio Rápido para Videos, un programa piloto disponible únicamente por invitación. Está dirigido a creadores seleccionados que publiquen videos verticales originales de menos de tres minutos y sin marcas de agua.
La iniciativa busca impulsar contenido producido específicamente para X, en lugar de publicaciones que hayan sido descargadas de otras redes sociales y compartidas nuevamente.
Otra incorporación son los Chats Grupales Exclusivos para Suscriptores, que permiten mantener conversaciones privadas en tiempo real con personas que pagan por acceder a contenido exclusivo de un creador.
Actualmente, esta herramienta está disponible para creadores con 800 suscriptores o menos. Cada grupo puede reunir hasta 1.000 participantes, lo que abre una alternativa para construir comunidades alrededor de cuentas que ofrecen suscripciones de pago.

Some of the most compelling deals are coming from Apple, of all companies, with discounts across its MacBook, iPad, and AirPods lineups. Nintendo's Switch 2 is seeing a rare price cut, OLED gaming monitors continue to become more affordable, and there are some genuinely excellent Windows laptop deals, including the Dell XPS 13 for $549 and an OLED-equipped HP OmniBook for just $449.
For PC enthusiasts, it's a more mixed picture. GPU deals are nonexistent, and meaningful discounts on SSDs are few and far between. CPUs are a brighter spot, with several AMD Ryzen and Intel CPUs available at attractive prices, in line with the recommendations in our recently updated CPU buying guide. It's also a great time to shop for mechanical keyboards, gaming mice, and noise-canceling headphones.
As we've done for years, we've sifted through hundreds of offers to bring you a handpicked selection of tech deals that are actually worth your attention. We're prioritizing products we'd recommend in the first place, not simply those sporting the biggest discount.

articles.title: European spacecraft finds chaotic scene after asteroid deflection experiment
articles.text:
This image from the Hera spacecraft's asteroid framing camera shows Didymos and its smaller companion Dimorphos, revealing the stadium-sized crater created by the impact of NASA's DART spacecraft in 2022.
Credit:
European Space Agency
This image from the Hera spacecraft's asteroid framing camera shows Didymos and its smaller companion Dimorphos, revealing the stadium-sized crater created by the impact of NASA's DART spacecraft in 2022.
Credit:
European Space Agency
Four years ago, NASA dispatched a small spacecraft on a suicide mission to show how humanity might deflect an asteroid on a collision course with Earth. The first-of-its-kind experiment worked beautifully as the solar-powered space probe slammed into asteroid Dimorphos, permanently altering its trajectory.
Using telescopes, astronomers measured changes in the orbit of Dimorphos around a larger asteroid companion named Didymos in the aftermath of NASA’s Double Asteroid Redirection Test (DART) mission. The spacecraft released some 10 billion joules of energy as it impacted Dimorphos in September 2022 at more than 13,700 mph (6.14 kilometers per second), shortening the asteroid’s 12-hour orbit around Didymos by about 33 minutes, 25 times the most conservative expectation.
But scientists could only learn so much from DART. The collision destroyed the spacecraft, as expected. DART recorded images as it took aim on Dimorphos, but only faraway telescopes and a small CubeSat that briefly detected the impact flash could see what happened next.
“We knew right away that the impact was successful, that DART made a really, really large mess,” said Sabina Raducan, a planetary scientist at the International Space Science Institute in Bern, Switzerland. “However, we didn’t really know what kind of mess. We were still missing pieces of the puzzle.”
Artist’s illustration of the Hera spacecraft with its two deployable CubeSats, Juventas and Milani, in the vicinity of the Didymos binary asteroid system.
Credit:
ESA-Science Office
Artist’s illustration of the Hera spacecraft with its two deployable CubeSats, Juventas and Milani, in the vicinity of the Didymos binary asteroid system.
Credit:
ESA-Science Office
Following up
The European Space Agency’s Hera spacecraft recently arrived in the vicinity of Didymos and Dimorphos after a two-year journey from a launch pad in Florida. On Wednesday, ESA released Hera’s first views of the scar left by DART on Dimorphos. The images show the car-sized impactor carved out a crater the size of a stadium, nearly as big as Dimorphos itself, a rugged chunk of extraterrestrial rock measuring about 500 feet (151 meters) across.
Mission planners selected Didymos and Dimorphos for the deflection experiment because they are similar to many near-Earth asteroids, but there’s no risk of them striking our home planet. Scientists weren’t sure what Hera would find when it got to the double asteroid, currently orbiting the Sun about 120 million miles (193.5 million kilometers) from Earth.
“I would say we had two kinds of predictions: either we made a crater, or we reshaped the asteroid,” said Patrick Michel, Hera’s principal investigator from Côte d’Azur Observatory in Nice, France. “In fact, we did both because the crater is so large that the shape has changed. Therefore, we are in a sort of a transition between just cratering and global transformation, and we are still not sure how this can happen.”
Hera found Didymos, the larger of the two asteroids, spinning on its axis just as DART observed on final approach in 2022. Dimorphos is no longer so stable.
“As Hera returned more images, it became clear that the DART impact has left Dimorphos tumbling wildly in its orbit,” says Michael Kueppers, ESA’s Hera mission scientist.
The Hera spacecraft will fly closer to Didymos and Dimorphos over the next six months to obtain more detailed observations. Hera will release two small sub-satellites to attempt landings on Dimorphos and collect data on the asteroid’s composition, internal structure, and mass.
Scientists will use this information to reconstruct the dynamics of DART’s impact four years ago and better understand how a future deflection mission might move an asteroid off a trajectory that actually threatens Earth. Near-Earth asteroids come in many shapes and sizes, with different densities and makeups, so knowledge of Dimorphos’s physical properties will anchor predictive computer models teaching scientists how best to deflect all types of asteroids.
“Once we understand, we have a breakthrough, which really solves planetary defense,” Michel said in an interview with Ars.
This is a composite image combining 11 long-exposure images from Hera’s Hyperscout-H instrument, centered on the Didymos asteroid. The dot trails correspond to hundreds of boulders of differing sizes in motion around the Didymos-Dimorphos system. The two asteroids have been subtracted from the image for improved visualization of the boulders. These images were acquired on November 6 with an approximate distance of 29.9 kilometers (18.6 miles) from the asteroids.
This is a composite image combining 11 long-exposure images from Hera’s Hyperscout-H instrument, centered on the Didymos asteroid. The dot trails correspond to hundreds of boulders of differing sizes in motion around the Didymos-Dimorphos system. The two asteroids have been subtracted from the image for improved visualization of the boulders. These images were acquired on November 6 with an approximate distance of 29.9 kilometers (18.6 miles) from the asteroids.
What a mess
In its initial reconnaissance this month, Hera spotted hundreds of boulders surrounding the double asteroid. This was not entirely unexpected. A picture taken by the Hubble Space Telescope shortly after DART’s impact showed a cloud of material streaming behind Didymos and Dimorphos, but scientists were astonished by the extent of the debris swarm in Hera’s first images.
“As we approached Didymos and Dimorphos, we quickly realized the asteroids were not alone,” said Naomi Murdoch, planetary scientist at the Institut Supérieur de l’Aéronautique et de l’Espace in Toulouse, France. “In fact, they had a lot of company.”
An image released by ESA on Wednesday combines 11 long exposure frames from Hera’s hyperspectral camera. Image processors on the ground digitally removed the relatively bright Didymos and Dimorphos to reveal a panoply of dimmer streaks and dots, each of which is a rock fragment ranging in size from a football to a washing machine, Murdoch said.
“Hera came to visit two asteroids, and we found hundreds of companions,” Murdoch said.
One obvious explanation for the boulders is they were thrown off Dimorphos when DART slammed into it. But scientists cautioned they need more information before they can say that with surety. Hera is the first space mission to undertake a sustained study of an asteroid with its own moon. The debris around the two asteroids might be relics from the creation of Dimorphos some time in the ancient past.
“Hera will allow us to study that in more detail,” Murdoch said. “We really need to know more about these boulders and characterize them to understand if they’re linked to DART, if they’re linked to another process, and what the consequences might be for other asteroid systems in the Solar System.”
The boulder field will create challenges for navigating around the asteroids. In particular, the boulders are an added risk for the two small CubeSats Hera is supposed to deploy in January.
“We saw a couple of images that didn’t reassure me,” said Margherita Cardi, project manager for the Milani CubeSat. “There is a mix of excitement and panic.”
Claudia Balossi, spacecraft systems engineer for Hera’s other CubeSat, named Juventas, said her mission’s planned trajectory would take it right through the boulders as it moves within a couple of miles of the asteroids, then finally toward a landing attempt on Dimorphos, where it will measure the miniature world’s tenuous gravity field.
“We are right in the middle of it,” Balossi said. “The smallest ones are probably just as big as we are and the biggest ones are very big. In the worst case, a boulder will land on us. We will activate our gravimeter right away [if that happens],” Balossi joked.
The good news is the asteroids’ gravity is so weak that Hera, Milani, Juventas, and the hazards around them all move at snail-like speeds. Hera’s current trajectory takes it around the asteroids at a relative velocity of just a quarter-mile per hour, or about 12 centimeters per second. At that speed, there’s no danger of a sudden catastrophic hypervelocity collision between the spacecraft and the boulders lurking nearby.
Scientists have seen this at an asteroid before. NASA’s OSIRIS-REx spacecraft kicked up an estimated six tons of rock and dust when it gently moved in to collect a sample from an asteroid named Bennu in 2020. Low gravity and weak surface cohesion are a recipe for outsized effects.
“These types of bodies, because of their low gravity, have a very counterintuitive behavior,” Michel said. “Each time we interact with them, whether to take a sample or to make an impact, the response of the surface was not the one we predicted, simply because our intuition relies on what we experience every day on Earth. Even if the rules of physics are the same in the Universe, they express very differently depending on local attraction.”
Stephen Clark is a space reporter at Ars Technica, covering private space companies and the world’s space agencies. Stephen writes about the nexus of technology, science, policy, and business on and off the planet.

articles.title: Firefox agora permite ativar VPN automaticamente em sites
articles.text:
Firefox agora permite ativar VPN automaticamente em sites
Novidade permite definir quais páginas devem sempre abrir com a VPN ligada. Firefox 161 também traz botão de apagar dados rapidamente para navegação comum.
Usuários do navegador Firefox agora podem programar a VPN integrada para ativar ou desativar automaticamente de acordo com o site acessado. A novidade chegou nesta terça-feira (24/11) com a versão Firefox 161 para computadores.
Segundo a Mozilla, o usuário pode criar regras individuais para determinar quais endereços devem abrir sempre com a VPN ligada. Depois da configuração, a preferência é aplicada automaticamente nas próximas visitas ao site. Além da VPN, a atualização também trouxe a exclusão rápida de dados de navegação para janelas comuns.
As configurações automáticas da VPN têm duas opções: Always on e Always off. A primeira faz com que a VPN seja ativada automaticamente quando o endereço for acessado. A segunda impede que aquele site seja aberto com a VPN, mesmo que o recurso esteja ligado.
A Mozilla cita como exemplo situações em que alguém pode querer usar uma VPN para consultar preços disponíveis em diferentes regiões, mas preferir acessar serviços bancários ou plataformas de streaming sem ela.
Assim, em vez de ligar e desligar o recurso a cada mudança de página, o navegador passa a lembrar a configuração escolhida para cada endereço. O recurso faz parte da VPN gratuita integrada ao Firefox para desktop, que, segundo a Mozilla, está sem limite de dados até 31 de janeiro de 2027.
Para ativar a VPN automática basta abrir o painel de VPN nas Configurações do navegador e encontrar a opção “Manage VPN rules”. Lá, é preciso informar o endereço e escolher entre os dois modos.
A versão 161 trouxe também o botão Fire às janelas convencionais do Firefox no desktop. O recurso já existia na navegação privada. Pelo botão na barra de ferramentas, é possível apagar rapidamente dados como:
- histórico de navegação e downloads
- cookies e dados de sites
- arquivos temporários
- informações salvas em formulários
- permissões e preferências concedidas a páginas
Outra novidade do Firefox 161 é a expansão da leitura de páginas em voz alta para o Android. A ferramenta, que já existia no desktop, funciona pelo Modo Leitor. No celular, basta abrir uma página compatível, tocar no ícone do modo de leitura na barra de endereço e selecionar o símbolo de fones de ouvido.

articles.title: QNAP Launches 2U 12-inch Short-Depth 8-Bay HDD NAS TS-h1065eU/TS-h1065eU-RP
articles.text:
Wednesday, November 25th 2026
QNAP Launches 2U 12-inch Short-Depth 8-Bay HDD NAS TS-h1065eU/TS-h1065eU-RP
QNAP Systems, Inc., a leading innovator in storage, networking, and data protection solutions, today introduced its new 12-inch short-depth NAS series, the TS-h1065eU and TS-h1065eU-RP. Equipped with eight 3.5-inch drive bays and two highly expandable E1.S/M.2 PCIe NVMe slots, these new NAS models provide large storage capacity, high performance, and flexible expansion in a compact 2U chassis. They are ideal for small to medium-sized businesses and edge deployment scenarios where space is limited.
Sean Teng, Product Manager of QNAP,"QNAP continues to enhance its exclusive short-depth NAS series to help businesses build storage solutions that balance capacity, performance, and data protection in space-constrained environments. The TS-h1065eU series is designed for users who need high storage capacity, cache performance, and data security, providing the optimal balance between long-term stability and overall cost-effectiveness."
TS-h1065eU/TS-h1065eU-RP product highlights
- High Reliability ZFS Storage: The ZFS-based QuTS hero operating system supports self-healing, inline data deduplication and compression, along with SnapSync disaster recovery and WORM data protection, ensuring data immutability while optimizing SSD performance for mission-critical workloads.
- 2U 12-inch Short Depth Design Saves 38% Rack Space: With a depth of just 30.48 cm (12 inches), the short-depth NAS series can be easily deployed in shallow racks, edge storage environments, or space-constrained areas such as data centers, AV rooms, and surveillance control rooms, maximizing the utility of limited space.
- DDR5 Memory for Performance and Reliability: Equipped with high-performance, low-power DDR5 memory (expandable up to 16 GB) and supports In-Band ECC (IBECC) to further enhance data integrity and system stability.
- Next-Generation Intel Quad-Core Processor with iGPU Acceleration: Powered by a quad-core processor with a clock speed burst up to 3.6 GHz, supporting AES-NI hardware encryption acceleration, and integrated Intel graphics (iGPU) for video decoding, display acceleration, and Intel OpenVINO AI inference acceleration (such as facial recognition), boosting the efficiency of surveillance and multimedia applications.
- Flexible Storage Expansion: Leverage the QXP-40G2UC expansion card for connecting two USB4 JBOD TL-R1210TC4-RP storage expansion devices, adding up to 24 additional hard drives to meet data growth and long-term backup needs.
- Excellent Network Connectivity and Storage Expansion Flexibility: Two 2.5GbE ports, and two E1.S / M.2 PCIe NVMe slots that can be configured as SSD cache or high-speed storage pools; paired with the QXG-ES10G1T E1.S network expansion card for 10GbE expansion. Port Trunking or SMB Multichannel further enhances bandwidth, meeting high-performance needs for fast transfers, large file accesses, and backup/restore operations. A PCIe slot is also provided for flexible expansion with a 2-port 10GbE NIC, storage expansion card, or QM2 M.2 SSD card.
- Ideal for Surveillance, AI Facial Recognition, and Edge Recording Applications: Equipped with high-capacity hard drives and iGPU video acceleration, ideal for deploying QNAP's QVR Surveillance Solution to centrally manage multiple camera feeds, run smart surveillance applications, and secure video footage. The iGPU, combined with the Intel OpenVINO inference engine, offloads AI video analytics to reduce CPU load, accelerating QVR Face real-time facial recognition, QVR Human people detection and counting, and QVR Smart Search for fast video retrieval.
- Redundant Power Supply for System Stability: The TS-h1065eU-RP features dual power supply redundancy, reducing the risk of power failure and enhancing business continuity by ensuring stable, uninterrupted service.
The TS-h1065eU and TS-h1065eU-RP NAS models are available now.
Sources:
				QNAP TS-h1065eU, 				TS-h1065eU-RP

articles.title: Europol annonce une opération contre 57 services d’IPTV pirate
articles.text:
Europol a perturbé 57 services d'IPTV pirate en suivant les paiements en cryptomonnaies de leurs abonnés, avec l'aide de Binance, de Coinbase et de Chainalysis. Plus de 26 millions d'euros de transactions ont été tracés, et l'analyse continue.
L'empêcheur de tourner en rond. Des policiers de onze pays ont passé cinq jours à Séville, au siège de la police nationale espagnole, du 16 au 20 novembre, sous la coordination d'Europol. Ils ont enquêté sur l'argent de l'IPTV pirate, ces offres de télévision par Internet qui donnent accès à des milliers de chaînes, au sport en direct et aux films pour quelques euros par mois, sans l'accord des ayants droit. D'après le communiqué d'Europol, l'opération a perturbé 57 services et permis de repérer 321 sites de diffusion illégale, qui totalisent plus de 7,3 millions de visites par an. Les polices nationales doivent encore mettre un nom sur les personnes qui encaissent cet argent.
Europol suit l'argent des abonnés jusqu'aux portefeuilles des pirates
En février, Europol avait soutenu l'opération Switch Off, qui a fermé trois grandes plateformes pirates en Italie. Mais l'agence européenne s'attaque davantage aux paiements, car fermer un service n'arrête pas forcément les criminels qui le dirigent. Pour Europol, l'IPTV pirate est « un marché criminel pesant des milliards d'euros par an ». Les vendeurs encaissent souvent les abonnements en cryptomonnaies, et leurs portefeuilles numériques leur permettent aussi de faire passer l'argent d'un pays à l'autre et d'en cacher l'origine, selon BleepingComputer.
À Séville, les enquêteurs ont donc suivi ces transactions d'une blockchain à l'autre, pour relier chaque service à ses portefeuilles, puis aux personnes qui les contrôlent, rapporte The Block. Les plateformes d'échange Binance et Coinbase ont participé à ce travail, avec Chainalysis, une société spécialisée dans l'analyse des blockchains. Les informations recueillies à Séville serviront aux enquêtes nationales, pour identifier les suspects, couper les services et retrouver leurs avoirs.
L'an dernier, à Alicante, une première semaine d'enquête sur ces paiements avait permis de tracer 47 millions d'euros en cryptomonnaies et de signaler 25 services pirates aux plateformes d'échange, selon Finance Magnates. À l'époque, Europol et ses partenaires estimaient qu'un service d'IPTV pirate sur cinq acceptait les cryptomonnaies.
Environ 60 millions d'Européens regardent l'IPTV pirate
L'AAPA, l'association européenne de lutte contre le piratage audiovisuel, a aussi participé à l'opération, avec Interpol et l'Office de l'Union européenne pour la propriété intellectuelle. D'après ses estimations, relayées par Europol, environ 60 millions de personnes utilisent ces services en Europe. Les diffuseurs légaux perdent 4,83 milliards d'euros par an, et les États 1,08 milliard d'euros d'impôts.
Une trentaine de policiers ont fait le déplacement à Séville. Ils venaient de Belgique, de Bulgarie, de Croatie, d'Espagne, des États-Unis, de Grèce, d'Irlande, d'Italie, des Pays-Bas, du Portugal et de Roumanie, selon The Block. La police française manque à l'appel.
Les gendarmes français mènent leurs enquêtes de leur côté. En juin, ceux de l'Unité nationale cyber ont démantelé Noos+. Selon eux, cette plateforme pirate aurait encaissé plus de 12 millions d'euros en cinq ans.
Et si vous payez un abonnement à l'un de ces services, vous enfreignez la loi, rappelle l'Arcom.

articles.title: Saudi AI startup 009 raises $1.4 million pre-seed led by Outliers Venture Capital
articles.text:
Saudi AI startup 009 raises $1.4 million pre-seed led by Outliers Venture Capital
- Saudi artificial intelligence startup 009 has raised $1.4 million in a pre-seed funding round, led by Outliers Venture Capital, with participation from angel investors.
- Founded in 2026 by Abdulrahman Bajaber and Mohammed Hashmi, the Riyadh-based startup develops AI agents that automate operational and administrative workflows within government entities and industrial enterprises.
- Its technology creates digital representations of organisational workflows, known as agent twins, which allow companies to identify operational bottlenecks and test automation using historical data before deploying AI agents in live environments.
- The fresh capital will support the development of its AI solutions, targeting sectors including manufacturing, mining, defence and government, with deployment options that allow organisations to retain control over sensitive operational data.
Press release:
Saudi Arabia-based artificial intelligence startup 009 has raised $1.4 million in a pre-seed funding round led by Outliers Venture Capital, with participation from a group of angel investors.
Founded in Riyadh in 2026 by Abdulrahman Bajaber and Mohammed Hashmi, 009 develops AI agents designed to automate administrative and operational processes within government entities and industrial enterprises.
The startup focuses on sectors including manufacturing, mining and defence, addressing operational challenges associated with complex internal processes, fragmented information systems and repetitive manual tasks.
Its platform analyses existing organisational records to identify operational inefficiencies, including duplicated data entry, delayed approvals and workflow bottlenecks. The technology then creates a digital representation of an organisation's operations, known as an agent twin, through which proposed automation processes can be evaluated using historical data before implementation.
The company's AI agents are designed to perform tasks such as reviewing permit applications, processing procurement requests, reconciling records across different systems and supporting maintenance operations.
In manufacturing, for example, the technology can help engineers investigate production defects by identifying relevant equipment, suppliers and previous incidents, providing the information needed to make operational decisions.
009's technology can be deployed within customers' existing infrastructure, including private cloud environments, on-premises servers and networks isolated from the internet. This approach enables organisations to retain control over their operational data, while maintaining human oversight and requiring approval for sensitive actions.
Co-founder Bajaber previously co-founded construction materials platform Watad and cybersecurity venture builder CyberME Studio.
The company plans to use the new funding to further develop its AI technology and support the deployment of its enterprise automation solutions, helping government and industrial organisations improve operational efficiency and reduce manual workloads.

articles.title: Dough, design, drool: food entrepreneurship insights from Bakery Business 2026
articles.text:
Dough, design, drool: food entrepreneurship insights from Bakery Business 2026
In this photo essay from Jio World Convention Centre in Mumbai, we showcase food industry highlights from the exhibition halls along with insights for innovators.
Launched in 2014, PhotoSparks is a weekly feature from YourStory, with photographs that celebrate the spirit of creativity and innovation. In the earlier 1,040 posts, we featured an art festival, cartoon gallery. world music festival, telecom expo, millets fair, climate change expo, wildlife conference, startup festival, Diwali rangoli, and jazz festival.
Looking to begin your entrepreneurial journey in the food space? A good event for product insights, industry trends, and professional networking would be the 19th annual edition of the Bakery Business trade show, being held this week at the Jio World Convention Centre, BKC, Mumbai.
Organised by Hospitality First, it is held alongside the 14th annual HoReCa Business exhibition for the hospitality, restaurants and catering industry. With around 200 exhibitors, it reportedly attracted 15,000 business visitors.
As seen in this photo essay, it features not just cutting-edge technology and ingredients, but also demonstrations and competitions. For example, The India Pizza Championship brought together talented pizzaiolos (artisan pizza chefs) from across the country to showcase their skills on a national platform.
Such events point to a number of trends in this space for food entrepreneurs: the rise of cloud kitchens, the combination of bakeries with indulgent dining experiences, the growth of institutional investment, and the proliferation of bakery and restaurant chains that involve central kitchens and heavy automation.
In this photo essay, we showcase some of the exhibitors at Bakery Business 2026, such as Mahe to the World, Tandoor King, Mavee's, Mala's, Stagioni, Celebre, Ecolane, Morde, Pro Dough, Bakersville, and others.
Tandoor King International is a Mumbai-based manufacturer and supplier of commercial tandoors and baking equipment. Its product range includes stainless-steel tandoors, mild-steel tandoors, clay tandoors, gas-operated tandoors, and charcoal tandoors.
Mahe is a new premium bakery brand launched by Bikaji Foods International in partnership with master baker TK Khaleel. It aims to bring European baking traditions and artisanal craftsmanship to the Indian market, via offerings such as semi-finished bakery bases that foodservice operators can customise.
Morde Foods is a leading manufacturer of chocolate and cocoa-based products, with a strong presence in the B2B segment. It supplies compound chocolates, chocolate fillings, spreads, toppings, decorations, and inclusions to chocolatiers and restaurants.
Bakersville India is a prominent supplier and manufacturer of bakery ingredients, food decoration products, baking tools, and food packaging solutions. It has developed a substantial distribution network across India, and operates retail outlets under the Food Décor Shop name.
Mala’s, based in Panchgani near Mahabaleshwar, is famous for its strawberry and fruit jams, crushes, syrups, sauces, and fresh fruit treats. It is a major fruit-product manufacturer with pan-India distribution and exports to over 20 countries.
Meeting such exhibitors and large players helps aspiring food entrepreneurs explore opportunities to launch new offerings, improve product quality, and differentiate their menu. They can evaluate how technology can improve consistency, reduce wastage, save labour, and increase production capacity.
Such technologies include commercial ovens, mixers, processing machinery, refrigeration, and automation solutions. They can help improve operating economics for standalone and chain systems.
The food ecosystem is enriched by a wide range of business models. Entrepreneurs can explore opportunities via bakery cafés, central kitchens, QSRs, and cloud kitchens. Such models help understand how new businesses can diversify beyond traditional retail sales.
Meeting ingredient manufacturers, equipment suppliers, distributors, and fellow entrepreneurs helps forge new relationships. Live demonstrations, professional competitions and knowledge activities can spur innovation in product categories.
In sum, such industry exhibitions help entrepreneurs benchmark prices, calculate the unit economics, discover new products, and explore the use of automation. They enable identification of growth opportunities and ideas for product lines.
The overall opportunity at such a trade show is not simply to buy better equipment or ingredients. It is to rethink how to launch, improve and scale a food business in a fast-changing world with ever-increasing customer expectations.
Now what have you done today to pause in your busy schedule and harness your creative side for a better world?
(All photographs taken by Madanmohan Rao on location at Bakery Business 2026.)

articles.title: S&P considers Nvidia credit downgrade over governance and 'key man' risks
articles.text:
S&P Global Ratings, one of the three major credit rating agencies, is considering downgrading Nvidia’s rating, citing concerns about the company’s management and governance practices.
Despite Nvidia’s strong financial performance, the ouster and reinstatement of CEO Jensen Huang has raised concerns about “weak executive oversight and lack of succession planning” and “key man risk,” meaning heavy reliance on Huang for its future success, S&P said in a statement.
The agency expects to finish its review within 90 days and could cut Nvidia’s rating from AA to AA-, the fourth-highest on its scale.
Although Nvidia is certain to keep its investment-grade rating, a downgrade could raise its borrowing costs. Because Nvidia backstops neoclouds and other infrastructure companies that lack strong credit on their own, a lower rating could make their debt costlier or force them to post more collateral.
In August, Nvidia announced plans to arrange $500 billion in financing for AI infrastructure with six financial institutions, including Goldman Sachs, Apollo, and Blackstone. Under the original terms, Nvidia would guarantee 25% of the loans. But even before Huang’s ouster and return, lenders had been demanding that Nvidia guarantee more, Bloomberg reported.
A downgrade would likely prompt lenders to demand even larger guarantees.

articles.title: Google search alternative Kagi launches Gmail rival
articles.text:
Kagi, a small, Palo Alto, California-based software company that provides a subscription-based search engine as an alternative to Google, has launched a Gmail-like e-mail service. Dubbed Kagi Mail, it makes many of the same claims as the search engine product: privacy, personal data sovereignty, customization, and control.
Additionally, Kagi is rolling out a calendar as part of the mail service. Right now, both the email and calendar interfaces are web-only, but native Android and iOS apps are planned for the fourth quarter of next year.
The email interface, currently in public beta, is minimalist. It emphasizes keyboard commands, as well as a private and ad-free experience. (You can see more details in Kagi’s blog post about what they mean by private.) Other feature offerings include unlimited aliases and domains, an anti-lock-in policy for user data, 50GB of storage, rule-based filtering with Sieve, an MCP server, and several optional, off-by-default AI features, like chatting with an agent to search email history, do large-scale re-labeling, or define additional filtering rules.
Some major features are still missing, though. As noted, there are no native apps yet. Critically, there is no contacts address book, but that is also coming in 2027 (Q1 in this case) according to the roadmap.
Like the search engine, Kagi Mail is a paid service. It’s not included in the $5 per month basic Kagi plan, nor is it in the $10 per month unlimited search plan. It is, however, included in the $25 per month Kagi Ultimate subscription, which also offers frontier AI models.
If you want to get Kagi Mail without the $25 per month subscription, you can subscribe for $9 per month or $99 per year, and there’s a 60-day trial right now.
Opinion: An alternative more of us should maybe consider
That’s a lot to pay for email when Gmail has historically been such a strong product. To most people, it seems ridiculous to imagine paying for a subscription, and that’s understandable.

articles.title: Some iPhone apps are abusing Live Activities, push notifications to send ads
articles.text:
A bunch of iPhone users are reporting seeing ads from various apps in ways that go against Apple’s policies.
As first reported by MacRumors, certain apps are being sent unwanted ads through Live Activities and push notifications. Per Apple’s own App Store rules, Live Activities should not include ads, while push notifications are similar not allowed to be used for promotions or direct marketing purposes unless customers are opted in. Despite that, iOS users say they’re still being served ads through Live Activities and push notifications.
Joe Rossignol, MacRumors’ Canadian senior editor, notes that he’s been getting ads through push notifications from the likes of Cineplex, McDonald’s, Wendy’s and SkipTheDishes. He says these have persisted even after opting out of push notifications in these respective apps.
He also took to social media to ask if others have been experiencing the same issue and said readers have reported similar issues. Some of them noted that DoorDash would prompt users to re-enable notifications to “never miss an order update” even when they never disabled them in the first place. Others, meanwhile, mentioned AliExpress has been advertising in Live Activities even though this is against App Store guidelines.
Never expected to see anything like this https://t.co/GbdRIfqaE2
— Out of Galaxy (@OutofGalaxyy) November 22, 2026
For what it’s worth, I don’t have the McDonald’s app installed (I’m forever spooked by former MobileSyrup editor Patrick O’Rourke being defrauded through it), while I do have the Wendy’s and Skip apps downloaded but use them very infrequently. That said, I’m an avid movie goer who’s regularly in the Cineplex app on my iPhone 17 Pro, but I haven’t received any of these pesky notifications in any app, so your mileage may vary.
Either way, these ads are pretty egregious. The whole benefit of Live Activities is to keep you updated on apps you’re currently using, whether that’s tracking flight information from Air Canada or seeing your progress mid-workout. It’s not meant for companies to be shoving ads down your throat. And naturally, push notifications still shouldn’t be going out even once you’ve disabled them, either.
Given that we’re hearing these reports about many different apps, it would seem this is an issue with Apple at the iOS level, rather than any specific third-party. It remains to be seen whether Apple will fix whatever is causing these notification frustrations.

articles.title: Biostar Introduces the EdgeComp MT-U325 Edge AI System
articles.text:
Wednesday, November 25th 2026
Biostar Introduces the EdgeComp MT-U325 Edge AI System
BIOSTAR, a leading manufacturer of edge AI solutions, industrial computers, motherboards, graphics cards, and storage devices, today introduced the EdgeComp MT-U325, a compact edge AI system powered by the Intel Core Ultra 5 325 processor (Panther Lake). Designed for system integrators and equipment manufacturers, the MT-U325 delivers up to 90 TOPS of AI performance without an additional accelerator and drives up to four displays, serving applications in smart retail, digital signage, smart manufacturing, industrial monitoring, and smart city security. 
The MT-U325 features an onboard Intel Core Ultra 5 325 processor with eight cores, clock speeds of up to 4.5 GHz, and a 25 W TDP. The integrated CPU, GPU, and NPU together deliver up to 90 TOPS of AI performance, allowing the system to run AI workloads locally without a separate accelerator. DDR5-7200 SO-DIMM memory is supported up to 128 GB, providing capacity for multitasking and on-site data processing.For multiscreen installations, the system offers four display outputs. Two HDMI 2.1 ports support resolutions of up to 7680 × 4320 at 60 Hz, and two DisplayPort 1.4 ports support resolutions of up to 4096 × 2160 at 120 Hz. A single MT-U325 can drive four screens at once, which suits multi-display digital signage, self-service kiosks, industrial HMI and control stations, and monitoring dashboards.
Storage and wireless expansion are handled by four M.2 slots. Two M.2 Key-M slots support NVMe SSDs, one 2280 slot through PCIe 5.0 x4 and one 2260/2280 slot through PCIe 4.0 x2, and a SATA III port is also available. The M.2 Key-B slot supports 3042/3052 4G/5G modules via PCIe 4.0 x1 and USB 3.2, with a SIM slot for cellular connectivity. The M.2 Key-E 2230 slot supports Wi-Fi and Bluetooth modules via PCIe 4.0 x1 and USB 2.0.
For wired networking, dual 2.5GbE LAN ports are powered by Intel I226-LM and I226-V controllers, with the I226-LM port supporting vPro for remote management. The two ports let integrators connect local equipment and the upstream network separately. The system also provides three USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-A ports, one USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-C port, and two USB 2.0 ports for peripherals and industrial devices. Onboard audio uses an ALC897 codec with an ALC105 amplifier. 
The MT-U325 is housed in a 1.7-liter chassis measuring 196.5 × 193 × 45 mm and weighs 1 kg, so it fits easily into space-constrained installations. Its wide-range 9-24 V DC input accommodates various power sources, and a 90 W power adapter is included. The system supports operating temperatures from 0°C to 50°C and humidity levels from 5% to 90%. It is compatible with Windows 11 64-bit, Windows 11 IoT Enterprise 24H2, and Ubuntu 24.04.
The EdgeComp MT-U325 combines on-device AI performance, quad-display output, high-speed networking, and wireless expansion in a compact system, giving system integrators a flexible platform for smart retail, digital signage, smart manufacturing, and smart city projects.

articles.title: Amazon Autos is coming to the UK with £99 car reservations — but you won’t get home delivery
articles.text:
Amazon Autos is about to change the way you buy a car in the UK — as experts say it could 'seriously disrupt' rivals like Autotrader
Online giant wants to make car shopping easier in 2027
- Amazon Autos launches in the UK in early 2027, with Hyundai confirmed as its first manufacturer
- Buyers will be able to compare vehicles, check finance options and reserve a car
- The final purchase, paperwork and collection will still happen at the dealership
Following the success of its automotive platform launch in the US, Amazon wants to make buying a car feel more like ordering a new TV, with its online car-shopping service arriving in the UK in early 2027.
Amazon Autos will let shoppers browse new and used vehicles, compare prices and finance options, get an estimate for their existing car and reserve their next set of wheels without having to drive around numerous dealer forecourts.
The UK will be the first market outside the US to get the service, and Hyundai is the first manufacturer confirmed for the British launch, with its range of electric, hybrid and gas-powered models set to appear on Amazon.co.uk.
Dealer group Vertu Motors has also signed up to list used and 'approved-used' cars.
While you won't be able to have a new car dropped on your driveway alongside your toilet paper or electric toothbrush purchase, the retailer is clearly hoping to make the early stages of the buying process feel much more familiar.
“Customers often are already logged in. They already have the Amazon app. They're familiar with the experience. Amazon Autos will look and feel like Amazon to them,” Matt Nuffort, director of Amazon Autos International, told James Baggott in an interview for Car Dealer Magazine.
This is where Amazon wants to capitalize. Buying a car is a massive financial commitment, and the process can involve hours of research, comparing dealer listings, working out finance payments and negotiating a part-exchange.
Sign up for breaking news, reviews, opinion, top tech deals, and more.
Amazon's pitch is that much of this can be handled through a website or app that shoppers already know how to use.
“Buying a car is one of the biggest purchases people make, and we think it should feel as simple and transparent as shopping for anything on Amazon,” Nuffort said in Amazon's UK launch announcement.
Potential customers will be able to sort results based on geographical location, or shop to a strict budget or features wishlist, with reservations for a new vehicle starting at just £99.
Amazon also says its platform can compare upfront prices and finance deals, including the popular personal contract purchase (PCP) and hire purchase (HP) options, alongside cash prices for buyers who don't want the monthly financial burden.
Buyers can also get a quick estimate on the value of their trade-in, based on model, mileage and condition.
However, the remainder of the buying journey is still handled by the dealership, with all paperwork and final trade-in values occurring in person.
Amazon says it is not cutting dealerships out of the process. Instead, it's trying to make the online research and shopping experience more straightforward, before handing the customer over to the retailer selling the car.
Analysis: Amazon has the power to disrupt
Autotrader has long been the dominant force in both new and used car sales in the UK, with numerous rivals burning through stacks of money in an attempt to take it on.
So far, the likes of CarWow and Motorway have got close, but most buyers in the market for a new vehicle still flock to Autotrader.
James Baggott, editor of CarDealer Magazine, told me that Amazon has the potential to “seriously disrupt the automotive advertising market”, because car dealers are “desperate for an alternative” that offers the same level of leads for a fraction of the cost.
Hyundai is the first new-car brand confirmed for the UK launch. Its selection will include the Ioniq 3 and Ioniq 5 electric cars, alongside the i20 and Kona, with petrol, hybrid and electric options available.
Vertu Motors will also list used vehicles, and Amazon says more brands and franchised partners will be announced ahead of launch.
That could be important for buyers: the more dealerships and brands Amazon attracts, the more useful it becomes as a place to compare cars.
It's also an area where Amazon will want to prove itself. A familiar shopping experience is one thing, but car buyers will still want a broad selection of vehicles, competitive prices and confidence that the dealer on the other end of the listing can deliver.
But its US operation appears to be a success, growing from 48 cities to more than 150, with vehicles from 35 brands available through the platform.
Amazon says its UK launch will build on that experience, although the full choice of cars available to British shoppers has yet to be confirmed.

articles.title: Primero el FBI, después la CIA y ahora el Tesoro: EEUU encadena incidentes de ciberseguridad y el último salpica a un videojuego
articles.text:
Desde localizar a una persona buscada por la justicia hasta investigar una posible operación de blanqueo de capitales, buena parte del trabajo de las autoridades estadounidenses pasa por consultar información almacenada en sistemas informáticos. Hablamos de herramientas que permiten cruzar datos, seguir investigaciones y compartir información entre organismos con competencias muy distintas. Su seguridad no depende únicamente de mantener los datos fuera del alcance de terceros, sino también de garantizar que quienes los necesitan puedan acceder a ellos. Una intrusión puede poner en entredicho ambas cosas.
En cuestión de días han trascendido tres incidentes de ciberseguridad que afectan a distintas instituciones de Estados Unidos. Primero conocimos una aparente intrusión en una base de datos del FBI, después un incidente que afecta a la comunidad de inteligencia, incluida la CIA, y, finalmente, un organismo del Departamento del Tesoro confirmó un acceso no autorizado a parte de sus sistemas. No hay constancia pública de que los tres casos estén relacionados. Sin embargo, el último ha adquirido una dimensión inesperada que tiene como protagonistas a un alto cargo del Gobierno, la inteligencia artificial y un videojuego.
El primer caso trascendió el 20 de noviembre y las informaciones apuntan al National Crime Information Center (NCIC), una base de datos del FBI que permite a las fuerzas policiales consultar registros sobre fugitivos, personas desaparecidas y bienes robados, entre otros. El organismo declinó pronunciarse cuando Associated Press le preguntó por la aparente intrusión. El 24 de noviembre salió a la luz otro incidente que afecta a la CIA y a la Oficina del Director de Inteligencia Nacional (ODNI), en un sistema dedicado al análisis de información procedente de fuentes abiertas. Según esta última institución, no se han producido interrupciones en los sistemas clasificados ni en las capacidades esenciales.
Un incidente que nos lleva hasta el Tesoro
El tercer caso nos lleva a la Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN), el organismo del Tesoro que, entre otras funciones, recibe informes de operaciones sospechosas de las entidades financieras para combatir delitos como el blanqueo de capitales. La agencia ha confirmado un acceso no autorizado a una parte limitada de sus sistemas y ha desconectado algunos como medida preventiva. También ha ampliado hasta el 30 de diciembre determinados plazos de presentación de informes para los declarantes afectados. Según una fuente consultada por Reuters, por el momento no hay evidencias de que se hayan comprometido las bases de datos de la Bank Secrecy Act ni de titularidad real de empresas.
Para encontrar el elemento más insólito de esta historia tenemos que salir de los canales oficiales del Gobierno estadounidense y entrar en GitHub. Allí, Sam Corcos, director de Información (CIO) del Departamento del Tesoro, tiene un repositorio público dedicado a Legatum, un proyecto personal inspirado en 'Civilization'. Se trata de un videojuego de estrategia todavía en desarrollo al que podemos jugar desde el navegador y que reproduce algunas de las mecánicas características de la saga, como la gestión de ciudades y el desarrollo tecnológico sobre un mapa dividido en hexágonos. Lo que a muchos les ha parecido llamativo es que el proyecto siguió recibiendo actualizaciones durante el incidente de FinCEN.
Corcos utiliza Vibe Coding, una forma de desarrollar software en la que damos instrucciones en lenguaje natural a herramientas de IA capaces de generar y modificar código. Buena parte del trabajo recae sobre agentes que pueden encadenar tareas con cierto grado de autonomía. Sus elementos gráficos se han generado mediante IA, mientras que la música y los efectos sonoros proceden de obras de terceros. 404 Media ha localizado modificaciones relacionadas con la música y las unidades militares, además de instrucciones atribuidas al propio Corcos, como su petición de incorporar arqueros en carros como unidad especial de Egipto.
La controversia ha acabado llegando al apartado de GitHub destinado a comunicar errores y sugerir mejoras. En lugar de señalar un problema del videojuego, varios usuarios han aprovechado una incidencia abierta en el repositorio para cuestionar las prioridades del responsable tecnológico del Tesoro mientras su departamento afronta un incidente de ciberseguridad. Desde la cuenta de Corcos se publicó una respuesta que recordaba que aquel espacio estaba reservado para cuestiones relacionadas con Legatum.
Por su parte, Corcos ha respondido a las críticas en X, donde ha explicado que los ordenadores trabajan por su cuenta. Los agentes de IA pueden mantener un proyecto en marcha sin requerir una intervención constante, por lo que la frecuencia de las actualizaciones no permite determinar cuánto tiempo ha dedicado personalmente al videojuego. Entretanto, el Tesoro trabaja con el FBI, la agencia de ciberseguridad CISA y especialistas forenses externos para esclarecer el alcance de la intrusión en los sistemas de FinCEN.

Actuellement noté 4/5 par notre rédaction, le Google Pixel 11 propose un format compact pratique en main et un écran OLED lumineux très agréable en extérieur. Pour le Black Friday 2026, son prix tombe à 648,99 € chez Amazon, soit une baisse d'environ 1 % pour 4,68 € d'économie.

À l'occasion du Black Friday, le smartphone descend à 648,99 € chez Amazon, soit environ 1 % de moins que le prix moyen constaté ces 30 derniers jours fixé à 653,67 €. Cela représente une économie de 4,68 €.
Un écran OLED très lumineux et un suivi logiciel étendu

articles.title: GTA 6 a trouvé un sérieux rival : The Witcher 4 promet un bond technologique impressionnant
articles.text:
Si les critiques concernant GTA 6 peuvent diverger sur certains points, notamment l’histoire racontée ou les libertés laissées aux joueurs, quasiment tout le monde semble s’accorder sur un point : le nouveau titre de Rockstar est visuellement magnifique et son monde ouvert impressionnant de réalisme. C’est simple, bon nombre de personnes estiment dorénavant que le monde ouvert de GTA 6 fait figure de référence ultime et que les performances technologiques du titre ne seront pas égalées avant de nombreuses années. Mais c’était peut-être sans compter sur The Witcher 4, prévu pour 2028.
The Witcher 4 : CD Projekt Red promet un saut technologique impressionnant
Lors de la présentation des résultats financiers du troisième trimestre de CD Projekt Red, Michał Nowakowski, co-dirigeant du studio, est venu apporter quelques informations concernant les améliorations apportées à The Witcher 4. En effet, une personne lui a demandé si le saut technologique entre GTA 5 et GTA 6 serait semblable à celui entre The Witcher 3 et The Witcher 4. Michał Nowakowski lui a répondu : « Nous pensons qu’il y aura un saut comparable entre The Witcher 3 et The Witcher 4 ; c’est en tout cas mon avis. Onze années se sont écoulées, et nous travaillons sur The Witcher 4 avec pour objectif d’offrir une qualité visuelle nettement supérieure, tout en améliorant pratiquement tous les aspects du jeu. Vous pouvez donc vous attendre à un saut bien plus important entre The Witcher 3 et The Witcher 4 ». Pour rappel, The Witcher 3 est sorti en 2015, soit il y a onze ans, comme le souligne le codirigeant de CD Projekt. The Witcher 4 sortira en 2028, soit 13 ans après la sortie du troisième volet. Un laps de temps qui correspond parfaitement à celui séparant GTA 5 et GTA 6.
Il ne serait toutefois pas judicieux de mettre sur le même plan les deux titres
Michał Nowakowski précise que Rockstar et CD Projekt Red ont des approches différentes et que leurs jeux ne répondent pas aux mêmes attentes. Il faut dire qu’il ne serait pas totalement judicieux de comparer la ville de Vice City, fourmillant de vie, au monde ouvert de The Witcher ou à celui de Red Dead Redemption 2. Enfin, notons que le codirigeant de CD Projekt Red assure que les ambitions du studio concernant The Witcher 4 et Cyberpunk 2 n’ont pas changé depuis la sortie de GTA 6.
Pour rappel, The Witcher 4 mettra en scène Ciri. Pour ce nouveau titre, CD Projekt Red a abandonné son moteur REDengine au profit de l’Unreal Engine 5 (Epic Games). CD Projekt Red a d’ores et déjà annoncé un partenariat exclusif avec Sony dans le cadre de la sortie du jeu, comme cela a été le cas pour GTA 6. Rappelons-le tout de même : un partenariat commercial n’implique pas de meilleures performances. Pour cause, GTA 6 semble en fin de compte mieux tourner sur Xbox Series X…
